dataset.name: demo
dataset.label: Demo league (synthetic)
dataset.license: Generated by this project (MIT). Fictional clubs; no real match data.
dataset.notes: Four seasons of a fictional 20-club league with promotion and relegation, simulated from drifting team strengths (`epl extract` with EPL_DATASET=demo regenerates it from a fixed seed). Results on it measure the pipeline, not real-world forecasting skill.
